notes: Audit of the 4 H1 harvest files (254 rows). Accuracy: 25 sampled, all 25 names shown raw on their src; 3 wrong as recorded (Sundial Brands is an owner, Told London's award was a candle, Kaiak is a fragrance) and 3 partly supported (the 2025 Pure Beauty 'reader-voted' label is not on the page). Register coverage of H1 is already large (1,472 names): Europe, Japan, Korea and wet shaving are saturated. Real gaps were heritage everyday icons of India, Thailand, Mexico, Lebanon and Africa, Indigenous makers, and designation-based regions. Öko-Test sunscreen 06/2025: the only 'sehr gut' products were retailer private labels (Sun D'Or/Edeka, Sundance/dm), which are out per BRIEF. Öko-Test face creams: Balea, Cien, Alverde, Alterra and Cadea Vera are private labels, also out.

tiering_notes.Pure Beauty 2026 (cosmeticsbusiness ...2: The page states the method: 'an independent panel of beauty industry experts selected the Judges Choice' -> quality for the 11 Judges Choice rows. Readers Vote rows on that page would be cultural.
tiering_notes.Pure Beauty 2025: The fetched page does NOT say the 2025 awards were reader-voted (the 2026 page calls the dual judges-and-readers process 'new'). Per the coordinator's instruction tier them cultural (trade or consumer vote), but the harvest's 'reader-voted' label is unsupported by its own src. Note that Told London (candle) and Lacura (Aldi private label) are out.
tiering_notes.Skin Cancer Foundation Seal: Not independent quality: only Corporate Council members paying 'an annual Corporate Council membership fee of $15,000' may apply; the Seal 'is awarded to individual sun protection products, not to brands'; the list also contains retailer own labels (Walgreens). Tier its 17 brands 'listed' unless another page supports them (EltaMD is already in the register).
tiering_notes.CHOICE sunscreen test: An independent lab test, so quality (Cancer Council). Mecca Cosmetica is the retailer's own label: merge into Mecca.
tiering_notes.Vogue India Beauty & Wellness Honours 20: 'Jury Winner' rows are juried, so quality; Kiro also won Reader's Choice.
tiering_notes.Market reports (Mordor, 6Wresearch, Data: market standing only, not quality and not renown. 6Wresearch is factually wrong on owners (it lists Trichup and Nihar under HUL; Nihar is Marico's, Trichup is Vasu Healthcare's): do not take owner data from it.
tiering_notes.Portfolio pages (H1_portfolio.json): Makers' own pages: existence only (listed) unless the brand has its own encyclopedia article. The Kenvue page shows Plax and Desitin only as logo links (URL text).
tiering_notes.Wikipedia category rows (H1.json): cultural only where the category member links to the brand's own article (true for the 8 sampled). The H1.json regions (e.g. 'Middle East (UAE/Gulf)', 'East Asia (Japan)') cite category pages that state no renown: renown false unless re-sourced.
tiering_notes.Hwahae / Glowpick awards (added K-beauty: selected from user-review data: a consumer vote, so cultural (standing), not quality.
tiering_notes.Thanaka navbox rows (Artistry, Natural W: a 'Major cosmetic brands' navbox on the Thanaka page is not a category or an article about the brand: listed unless own article shown.
